name: @balanceframe/scenario-kit
description: Typed feature scenarios and isolated Actual seed inputs

scripts.build: tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { dirname } from 'node:path'; import { EVIDENCE_SCENARIO_FIXTURES } from './dist/scenario-kit/src/evidence-scenario-support.js'; for (const name of ['scenarios/household', 'scenarios/merchant', ...EVIDENCE_SCENARIO_FIXTURES]) { const target = 'dist/protocol/fixtures/' + name + '.json'; mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('../../protocol/fixtures/' + name + '.json', target); }"
